title: [29.x]-All VAT Entries are gone through without filters with "Set G/L Account No." function.
summary: The Set G/L Account No. action on the VAT Entries page now correctly processes only selected or filtered entries instead of updating all entries in the database. The G/L - VAT Reconciliation report also now applies filters appropriately when processing VAT statement lines.
key_points: SetGLAccountNo action now uses SetSelectionFilter to process only selected or filtered VAT entries
Buckets process from first to last selected entry number without overlapping
Bucket range uses separate filter group to preserve selection filters
G/L - VAT Reconciliation report only adjusts G/L Account No. for VAT Entry Totaling lines
Fixes performance issue where large companies with millions of entries experienced long processing times
quote: All VAT Entries are gone through without filters with "Set G/L Account No." function.
